_comment: Per-footprint data KiCad does not carry: body height above the board, the part's role, the openings the enclosure must provide, and a rotation offset that makes rotation 0 mean the same physical orientation across footprint libraries. See backend/app/boards/SCHEMA.md.

kicad:BatteryHolder_Keystone_3002_1x2032.height_source: estimate: CR2032 cell (3.2 mm) plus retainer; confirm against the Keystone 3002 drawing

kicad:Sensirion_DFN-4-1EP_2x2mm_P1mm_EP0.height_source: Sensirion SHTC3 datasheet, 2 x 2 x 0.75 mm DFN

snapeda:SW_B3U-1000P.height_source: Omron B3U-1000P datasheet, 1.6 mm including actuator

nrfmicro:E73-2G4M08S1C-52840.height_source: estimate for the Ebyte E73-2G4M08S1C module with shield; confirm against the Ebyte datasheet
nrfmicro:E73-2G4M08S1C-52840._rotation_comment: This footprint draws the antenna end along +x; the offset makes rotation 0 mean antenna towards +y, as in the snapeda footprint.

snapeda:E73-2G4M08S1C.height_source: estimate for the Ebyte E73-2G4M08S1C module with shield; confirm against the Ebyte datasheet
snapeda:E73-2G4M08S1C._openings_comment: The antenna keep-out is the footprint's Dwgs.User keep-out band (3.5 mm at the antenna end), clipped to the module width.
